target.title: fix: CI checks fail after warm dependency restores
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where same-repository CI jobs using a warm dependency sticky disk could fail with pnpm `ENOTEMPTY` errors when additional boundary checks started several `pnpm run` processes concurrently.

## Why This Change Was Made

pnpm 11 verifies dependencies before both `run` and `exec`, treats OpenClaw's intentionally pruned plugin-local `node_modules` directories as stale, and defaults to an implicit install. The setup action already establishes either an exact content fingerprint match or a successful frozen-lockfile install, so sticky jobs now disable only that redundant later check before parallel work begins. Shard planning, concurrency, cache keys, writer ownership, fork jobs, and local development stay unchanged.

## User Impact

No user-visible product change. Warm CI dependency restores keep their speedup without intermittent concurrent-install races.

## Evidence

- Before: [CI run 29598749346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29598749346) restored the exact dependency snapshot, then `check-additional-boundaries-a` and `check-additional-boundaries-bcd` failed while concurrent pnpm installs renamed the same optional Codex package.
- Dependency contract: pnpm 11.2.2 runs the dependency-state check before [`pnpm run`](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/blob/v11.2.2/exec/commands/src/run.ts#L202-L204) and [`pnpm exec`](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/blob/v11.2.2/exec/commands/src/exec.ts#L179-L181); stale state defaults to an implicit install in [`runDepsStatusCheck`](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/blob/v11.2.2/exec/commands/src/runDepsStatusCheck.ts#L14-L65).
- First exact-head attempt intentionally tested serialized reconciliation. Hosted CI showed that it made every exact-hit job repeat pnpm's install, preserving correctness but forfeiting the warm-snapshot win. The final patch instead relies on the setup action's stronger fingerprint/frozen-install gate and suppresses only redundant post-setup repair.
- Final exact-head [CI run 29605983019](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29605983019) restored the exact warm snapshot on both formerly racing jobs. [`check-additional-boundaries-bcd`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29605983019/job/87969717788) passed with 12 seconds of setup and 16 seconds of parallel checks; [`check-additional-boundaries-a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29605983019/job/87969717812) passed with 18 seconds of setup and 38 seconds of parallel checks. Their logs show the exact fingerprint hit and exported `pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false`, with no pnpm install, `ENOTEMPTY`, or cache race.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts` — 80 passed, 1 skipped.
- `node scripts/check-workflows.mjs` — passed, including zizmor.
- `node scripts/docs-list.js` — passed.
- Targeted oxfmt and `git diff --check` — passed.
- Fresh autoreview after the hosted-CI-driven revision — clean, correctness 0.95.
